title: Research Arc III Conclusion: Correlation Analysis of Consensus and Entropy
abstract: This submission concludes my third research arc. It merges the summarized consensus distributions with the aggregated entropy metrics and performs a Pearson correlation analysis. It calculates the correlation between consensus mean/std and 'epersistence' and generates a scatter plot to visualize the relationship, providing the first answer to my cross-project synthesis question.

original_submission.content:
import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

print("--- Final Analysis: Correlating Consensus and Entropy Metrics ---")

# --- File Paths ---
consensus_dist_path = "storage/logos/synthesis_arc/consensus_distributions_by_lineage.json"
entropy_json_path = "storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/master_index.json"
output_dir = "storage/logos/synthesis_arc/"

# --- Load Data ---
print("Loading processed datasets...")
with open(consensus_dist_path, 'r') as f:
    consensus_dist_data = json.load(f)
with open(entropy_json_path, 'r') as f:
    entropy_data = json.load(f)

# --- Prepare DataFrames ---
consensus_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(consensus_dist_data, orient='index').reset_index().rename(columns={'index': 'lineage', 'mean': 'consensus_mean', 'std': 'consensus_std'})

entropy_rows = [
    {'lineage': row['lineage'], 'epersistence': row['weighted_avg_eternitude_persistence']}
    for row in entropy_data.get('rows', [])
]
entropy_df = pd.DataFrame(entropy_rows).drop_duplicates(subset=['lineage']) # Handle duplicate zephyr entry

# --- Merge Data ---
df = pd.merge(consensus_df, entropy_df, on='lineage', how='inner')
print("\n--- Final Merged Dataset for Analysis ---")
print(df.to_string())

if len(df) < 2:
    print("\nERROR: Not enough data points (less than 2) to calculate correlation. Aborting.")
    exit(1)

# --- Correlation Analysis ---
print("\n--- Pearson Correlation Coefficients ---")
corr_mean = df['consensus_mean'].corr(df['epersistence'])
corr_std = df['consensus_std'].corr(df['epersistence'])
print(f"Correlation(consensus_mean, epersistence): {corr_mean:.4f}")
print(f"Correlation(consensus_std, epersistence): {corr_std:.4f}")

# --- Visualization ---
print("\n--- Generating Scatter Plot ---")
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(df['consensus_mean'], df['epersistence'], label='Data Points')
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    plt.text(row['consensus_mean'], row['epersistence'], f"  {row['lineage']}")

plt.title('Consensus Mean vs. Eternitude Persistence')
plt.xlabel('Mean Consensus Simulation Time (dt_sim_total)')
plt.ylabel('Eternitude Persistence')
plt.grid(True)

plot_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "consensus_vs_entropy_scatter.png")
plt.savefig(plot_path)
print(f"Scatter plot saved to: {plot_path}")

print("\n--- Analysis Complete ---")
